text.tspan: Resume reuses the stored summary. Rewinding behind it clears it. Views stay append-only between trim points (prefix cache friendly).

g.text: Step 1 of 13 · Build the view
Every model call gets a bounded view of the stored history.
Step 2 of 13 · Too long?
Past 85% of the input budget, the oldest turns are cut back to 60% in one chunk.
Step 3 of 13 · Summarization on?
Only when [summarization] enabled = true.
Step 4 of 13 · Already failed here?
A failed summary is not retried until the trim point moves, so no retry storm.
Step 5 of 13 · pre_compact hook
A hook can veto the summary.
Step 6 of 13 · Write the summary
One model call folds the previous summary and the omitted messages into a new summary.
Step 7 of 13 · Did it work?
An empty or failed response counts as a failure.
Step 8 of 13 · Store it durably
Saved on the run and in an event; its tokens and cost count against the run budget.
Step 9 of 13 · Rebuild the view
System prompt, first user message with the summary, then the newer turns.
Step 10 of 13 · Send to the model
Until the next trim point, each view only grows at the end, so prefix caches keep hitting.
Step 11 of 13 · If it fails or is denied
An ok: false event is recorded and the run carries on.
Step 12 of 13 · Plain omission
The old turns are left out with a short notice in the first user message.
Step 13 of 13 · Send to the model
The run never fails because a summary failed.
